profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 6+ years of experience building backend services, enterprise applications, and data pipelines.

positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Software Engineer Technical Lead
positions.description:
I lead a backend development of backend services for our dispatching system.

  Responsibilities:
  • Provide technical direction for the dispatching engine, gathering requirements from subject matter experts and delegating tasks across the engineering team
  • Lead rebuild of a third-party integration system using modern web technologies
  • Establish coding standards, documentation practices, and testing guidelines for the team

  Achievements:
  • Increased code coverage from 0% to 60%+ by authoring 181 unit tests for a legacy Delphi codebase
  • Reduced cross-team communication overhead by creating comprehensive API documentation for frontend engineers
  • Accelerated bug identification by building internal WebSocket testing tools, replacing manual UI-based testing with JSON-driven test scenarios

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I worked on enterprise Windows and web applications supporting emergency dispatch operations.

  Responsibilities:
  • Designed and developed enterprise-level Windows and web applications
  • Built user management APIs and background workers for license management
  • Developed proof-of-concept applications for stakeholder review

  Achievements:
  • Streamlined license management by designing APIs and background workers using ASP.NET and SignalR

positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.description:
I built data pipelines and web crawlers that helps manufacturers and distributors manage product data.

  Responsibilities:
  • Developed and maintained web crawlers to ingest product data from multiple sources
  • Collected, cleaned, and organized product data for client reporting
  • Built backend APIs to support internal data services

  Achievements:
  • Ingested 1M+ products by building 30+ web crawlers using Scrapy
  • Generated actionable client insights by organizing product data in MySQL
  • Improved code quality by implementing CI/CD pipelines and conducting code reviews

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I maintained and developed enterprise applications for campus IT operations, reporting directly to the IT Director.

  Responsibilities:
  • Maintained enterprise Windows and web applications for campus operations
  • Developed a campus-wide computer system log tracker

  Achievements:
  • Reduced rendering time by 60% by redesigning an ASP.NET web application
  • Automated daily IT reports by building a log tracking system using Windows Service and WPF
